jobs.title: Domain Engineer
jobs.description:
Shine is the financial copilot for entrepreneurs and small business owners.

Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin.

Part of something bigger

Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants.

Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe.

We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal.

Your Hiring Experience Matters

Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive.

If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.

The ERP Engineering Team at Shine

We're a fast-growing engineering team on a mission to build the best ERP for Small Businesses in Europe. We work in a domain-based structure, where each domain has real ownership over its area — from architecture to quality and technical roadmap.

Your Role as a Domain Engineer

As a Domain Engineer, you're the technical reference for the product: you define architecture direction, ensure engineering standards, and work closely with team managers and Senior Engineers to make sure technical decisions serve the business goals. This is a senior IC role, focused on cross-cutting technical impact, not people management.

We're modernizing our stack and expanding into new markets, which means real problems around scale, multi-tenancy, and domain complexity — not greenfield, but not paralyzing legacy either.

What You'll Do

Own the target architecture of your domain and the realistic path to get there.
Ensure reliability, scalability, security, and compliance are design constraints from day one, not afterthoughts.
Maintain living architecture documentation (C4 model diagrams, ADRs) as part of the engineering workflow.
Set and calibrate design review thresholds, delegating to senior engineers as their judgment grows.
Spend roughly half your time embedded with engineering teams, and half on cross-engineering work — standards, the Golden Path, and the Architecture Forum.
Grow the architectural judgment of senior engineers, so fewer decisions need to come through you over time.
Partner with Engineering Directors, Engineering Managers, and Product to surface technical constraints and trade-offs with clarity.

📍 Job located in Porto with possibility of two remote working days per week.

About You

Scalable systems experience: You have significant hands-on experience designing and evolving systems at scale, ideally within multi-tenant SaaS or platform environments.
Architectural ownership: You take end-to-end ownership of architecture decisions. You ensure your reasoning is well-documented so others can easily understand the context and trade-offs later.
Influence without authority: You are comfortable operating with technical authority and guiding direction without needing formal line-management authority.
Cross-functional communication: You can translate complex technical trade-offs into clear, legible concepts for Product managers and business leadership.
Empowerment over centralization: You have a genuine interest in developing other engineers' judgment rather than centralizing decision-making around yourself.
Tech stack & domain experience: You are comfortable with .NET, Angular, SQL Server, Azure, and modern CI/CD practices. Experience with financial, accounting, or ERP systems—as well as European regulatory compliance—is a strong differentiator.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We follow the principle of equal treatment to consider all job applicants and do not discriminate based on their gender, sexual orientation, color, racial or ethnic origin, religion, disability, etc. as per applicable law.

Our recruitment process

1️⃣ A 45' first call with Marc (Talent Acquisition Specialist) to get to know you better and share more about Ageras.

2️⃣ A 90' Technical Interview with one of our Domain Engineers to dive into Architecture and Coding topics

3️⃣ A 45' Manager interview with Rui (Senior Engineering Manager) to dive deeper into our set up.

4️⃣ A 60' Practical Assessment with one of our Domain Engineer.

jobs.title: Software Developer Intern
jobs.description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.

Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.

The Software Developer Intern supports the development and testing of software applications while gaining hands-on experience across different areas of the tech stack. This role is ideal for students or recent graduates exploring future paths in front-end, back-end, full-stack or test automation. Interns work closely with experienced engineers and product teams in an Agile/Scrum environment to learn modern technologies, development workflows, and quality assurance practices.

Key Responsibilities

Assist in writing clean, maintainable code for front-end or back-end components, in case of back-end, front-end or full-stack direction
Help build and test features under guidance from senior developers and QA engineers, in case of test automation direction
Learn and apply basic principles of UI/UX design, usability, and accessibility, in case of front-end direction
Participate in Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives
Collaborate with developers, designers, and platform engineers to understand project workflows
Contribute to documentation and follow coding and testing standards
Explore different technologies and tools used in software development and testing
Ask questions, seek feedback, and grow through mentorship and hands-on practice

Interns Will Gain Exposure To

Languages & Frameworks: Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular or React
Testing Tools: Cypress, Playwright, JUnit
Version Control & CI/CD: Git, GitHub Actions, Jenkins
Design & UX: Figma, Lit, Material UI, Tailwind, PrimeNG
Cloud & Containers: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS

Required Qualifications

Active student status at a Hungarian university or college (aktív hallgatói jogviszony).
Availability to work at least 20 hours per week during the semester.
Ability to work from our Budapest office on a regular basis, as in-person attendance is required.
Good Hungarian and English communication skills.
Basic programming knowledge in one or more languages (Java)
Familiarity with web technologies like HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, in case of front-end or full-stack direction
Interest in learning frameworks such as Angular, React, or Spring Boot
Basic knowledge of testing concepts or tools (e.g., Cypress, Playwright, JUnit)
Understanding of version control tools like Git
Willingness to learn and collaborate in a team environment

Preferred Qualifications

Final-year university students are strongly preferred, particularly those seeking to complete their mandatory internship (kötelező szakmai gyakorlat) as part of their degree program.
Experience with personal or academic projects in development or testing
Familiarity with design tools (e.g., Figma) or basic UI/UX concepts, in case of front-end direction
Interest in cloud platforms, container tools, or emerging technologies like AI
Basic knowledge of Agile/Scrum practices through coursework or team projects

Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.

If you share our passion for problem-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?

We respect the privacy rights of individuals and are committed to handling Personal Information responsibly and in accordance with all applicable privacy and data protection laws. Review our Privacy Policy here."

jobs.title: Principal AI & Data Cloud Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
At UNION, we believe in keeping communication simple, clear and human – not only with our customers, but also with one another. According to our employee surveys, our strengths include flexibility, a wide variety of tasks, a positive atmosphere and a genuine sense of curiosity. At the same time, we offer the stability and resources of a large corporate organization, combined with opportunities for individual professional growth.
Thanks to the feedback of our employees, UNION has earned the Great Place to Work certification, recognizing us as one of the best workplaces in Hungary. In 2025, UNION Insurance was also named the most attractive employer in the financial services category, based on the opinions of employees surveyed in Hungary as part of the Randstad Employer Brand Research.
Our principal shareholder is the Austrian VIENNA INSURANCE GROUP, one of the largest insurance groups in Central and Eastern Europe, with a history spanning nearly 200 years.

Role Summary:

The Principal AI & Data Cloud Platform Engineer will be responsible for defining the architecture, standards and technical direction of our enterprise Azure Data & AI Platform. This role will work closely with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Cloud Platform Engineers, Security Engineers and Governance Analysts to build a scalable, secure and modern cloud platform supporting data engineering, advanced analytics, machine learning and AI workloads.
The role combines strong cloud data platform engineering expertise with technical leadership across MLOps and AI platform capabilities, ensuring that data and machine learning solutions can move efficiently from experimentation to secure, reliable and governed production environments.

Responsibilities:

Design and own the Azure Native Data & AI Platform architecture
Lead Azure Databricks platform implementation and evolution
Define enterprise data, analytics, ML and AI platform standards and best practices
Design Lakehouse and Medallion architectures
Define the technical architecture and standards for enterprise MLOps capabilities
Define patterns for operationalizing machine learning models from development through production
Define standards for model lifecycle management, deployment and monitoring on the platform
Drive the adoption and evolution of MLflow and related ML lifecycle capabilities
Define reusable platform capabilities that enable Data Scientists to develop, deploy and operate machine learning solutions efficiently
Establish architectural patterns for batch and real-time model inference and model serving
Drive platform scalability, reliability, observability and performance
Lead Infrastructure as Code adoption
Design CI/CD standards and patterns for data, ML and platform components
Drive automation across data and machine learning solution lifecycles
Mentor engineering teams and provide technical leadership
Collaborate with Data Scientists on productionization patterns and technical requirements for ML and AI solutions
Collaborate with Security and Governance teams to ensure secure and governed data and AI workloads
Evaluate emerging Azure, Databricks, Machine Learning and Generative AI capabilities
Support enterprise architecture and technology roadmap planning

Required Skills:

7+ years of experience in Data Engineering, ML Engineering, Cloud Platform Engineering, or a related field.
3+ years of experience designing and developing enterprise-scale Azure Data Platforms or comparable cloud platforms on AWS or GCP.
Strong experience with Azure Databricks, Apache Spark, and distributed/parallel data processing.
5+ years of hands-on experience with Python and strong SQL skills.
Strong understanding of modern data architectures, including Delta Lake, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, and Azure Data Factory.
Solid understanding of machine learning lifecycles, MLflow, and MLOps architecture, including model deployment and productionization patterns.
Proven experience with CI/CD, Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, and Infrastructure as Code using Terraform.
Strong enterprise architecture experience, with the ability to design scalable, secure, and maintainable cloud data and AI platforms.
Proven technical leadership and mentoring experience, with the ability to drive architectural decisions and take end-to-end ownership of complex initiatives.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Excellent professional communication skills in English.

Nice to Have:

Experience with Azure Machine Learning or comparable enterprise ML platforms.
Experience with enterprise data governance and metadata management platforms such as Unity Catalog or Microsoft Purview.
Experience with data quality frameworks, lineage, access governance, and data discovery.
Experience with Feature Store concepts, model serving, and batch or real-time inference architectures.
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized workloads.
Experience with Azure OpenAI, Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG, and vector database architectures.
Experience with event-driven architectures and streaming technologies such as Azure Event Hubs or Kafka.
Azure Solutions Architect certification.
Databricks Professional Certification.

Why join us?

You’ll have the opportunity to take on independent, responsible tasks and make a real impact.
You can work from home for most of the month, giving you the flexibility to balance work and everyday life.
We look forward to seeing you in the office on team days, where you’ll enjoy a modern, comfortable and high-quality working environment.
We offer an attractive benefits package, including cafeteria package, company insurance plans, a company mobile phone and employee discounts.
Your health and well-being matter to us. That’s why all our employees have access to health insurance services, which can also be extended to cover family members.
We’re more than just a workplace – we’re a community. You’ll have plenty of opportunities to take part in community and CSR initiatives, as well as company events throughout the year.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer (remote within Bulgaria, all genders)
jobs.description:
Your challenge

As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (all genders)
, you will play a key role in building and evolving Hubject's cloud-native eMobility platform. Working across backend, frontend and cloud infrastructure, you will design, develop and operate scalable, secure and high-performing applications that power electric mobility worldwide. You will collaborate closely with Product, Architecture, QA and DevOps to deliver reliable software, shape technical decisions, and continuously improve our engineering practices.

Why Hubject

We develop ideas and deliver solutions for the eMobility market
We are working on the most important growth topics
We are an international team of very motivated eMobility enthusiasts
AND
We have over 30 benefits different categories:
Mobility (BVG subsidy)

Health & sports (Urban sports membership M)

Equipment (Laptop etc)

Learning and development (yearly training budget and Udemy learning platform access)

Hubject Lifestyle (Voiio membership)

Family-friendly environment (flex working time)

Your Tasks

Design, develop and maintain scalable full-stack applications using Java, Spring Boot, Angular and TypeScript.
Build secure REST APIs and intuitive, responsive user interfaces while following clean code and software engineering best practices.
Develop and operate cloud-native applications on AWS using Docker, Kubernetes and modern CI/CD pipelines.
Ensure high software quality through automated testing, code reviews, performance optimization and continuous improvement.
Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Designers, QA, Architects and DevOps teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
Troubleshoot, analyze and resolve complex technical issues while improving application reliability, scalability and security.
Mentor other engineers, contribute to technical discussions and help establish engineering best practices across the team.

Your Profile

Several years of experience developing full-stack applications using Java, Spring Boot, Angular, TypeScript, HTML5 and SCSS.
Strong understanding of microservices, REST APIs, distributed systems and modern software architecture.
Hands-on experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines and Git in cloud-native environments.
Experience with relational and NoSQL databases (e.g. PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Redis) and automated testing frameworks.
Solid knowledge of clean code principles, software design patterns, secure software development and performance optimization.
Excellent problem-solving skills, ownership mindset and ability to work effectively in cross-functional Agile teams.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (or equivalent practical experience)

Language

Fluent in English (company language)

Start date

as soon as possible

Location

Full Remote within Bulgaria

Hybrid set-up:
1-2 days per week at the office, rest remote from the comfort of your home :)

EUREF Campus in Schöneberg in Berlin - Europe's hotspot for green technology and eMobility

About us

Hubject
is the market and innovation leader in the eMobility sector. Together with our team, we develop ideas and deliver solutions for the eMobility market. This will become the most important growth topic worldwide in the coming years.

Our vision becomes our mission:
We accelerate the EV ecosystem towards a sustainable mobility future.

Our Values are:

We are Curious
We are Ambitious
We are Accountable
We are Inclusive

These four core values shape our collective identity and guide us as we navigate challenges, pursue growth, and make a positive impact in our industry and beyond. We are curious. We are ambitious. We are accountable. We are inclusive.

At Hubject, we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.

More about us

Hubject simplifies the charging of electric vehicles. Through its eRoaming platform, called intercharge, the eMobility specialist connects Charge Point Operators or CPOs and eMobility Service Providers or EMPs, thus providing standardized access to charging infrastructure regardless of any network.
With over one Million connected charging points and more than 2250 B2B partners across 63 countries and four continents, Hubject has established the world’s largest cross-provider charging network for electric vehicles by connecting CPO networks. In addition, Hubject is a trusted consulting partner in the eMobility market, advising automotive manufacturers, charging providers and other EV-related businesses looking to launch eMobility services or implement Plug&Charge using ISO 15118. In essence, Hubject promotes eMobility and its advancement worldwide.
Founded in 2012, Hubject is a joint venture of the BMW Group, Bosch, EnBW, Enel X, Mercedes-Benz, E.on, Siemens, and the Volkswagen Group. Hubject’s headquarters is located in Berlin, with subsidiaries in Los Angeles and Shanghai.
